page.overview:
Who is 1139?

1139 was a clone trooper who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Once during a mission, 1139 and their fellow clone trooper, 1137 were forgotten on a desert planet after their unit miscounted and departed. Ultimately, this proved fortuitous, for while abandoned the two soldiers learned of a CIS secret weapon project. As dutiful soldiers, 1139 and their companion resolved to destroy it. To aid in this endeavor, they built a TX-130 fighter tank, with which they destroyed the Separatist weapon. Soon thereafter, realizing their absence, a Republic gunship returned to retrieve the duo.

Having proven their competence, 1139, together with 1137, were then assigned to hunt the missing astromech droid R2-D2, their squad ordered by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine to find them before the Jedi. Travelling in a Nu-class attack shuttle, their first stop was the sector where R2-D2 was last seen, taking directions from a group of Rocket battle droids who were floating through space. Landing on an unidentified planet as their scanners picked up various droid signatures.. After struggling to find any droids, the clone squad was ambushed by various B1 and B2 battle droids, 1139's commander ordered their shuttle to give them cover fire while the other clones attacked the droids head on. The clone squad were able to quickly overwhelm them and steal the droid forces' Armored Assault Tank, only to be bombed from above by the clone forces in the shuttle, who had mistaken them for the enemy.

Waking up the unconcious 1137, 1139 began work on rebuilding their squadron's arsenal, only for their squad to be ambushed by a further wave of Armored Assault Tanks.
